enabled.Name: Enable Sheet Ping
enabled.Hint: Post compact public pings from the official character and NPC sheets.

zEnabled.Name: Enable ping input
zEnabled.Hint: Use the selected input to ping sheet targets, map tokens and empty map points on this client.

allowObserverPings.Name: Allow observer pings
allowObserverPings.Hint: Allow users with OBSERVER permission to ping from character and NPC sheets. Disable to restrict sheet pings to owners and GMs.

inputMode.Name: Ping input method
inputMode.Hint: Select the input for sheets and maps. Defaults to middle click; changes apply immediately.

Inspiration.Label: Inspiration
Inspiration.PingHint: Click using the configured ping input
